title: Senior Mainframe Systems Programmer - ISV z/OS-2
description:
We are seeking an experienced ISV z/OS Systems Programmer with strong expertise in the installation, maintenance, troubleshooting, and migration of Independent Software Vendor (ISV) products on the IBM z/OS platform. This role will focus heavily on evaluating, replacing, and migrating Broadcom (CA) mainframe products with alternative solutions while maintaining operational stability and performance.
The ideal candidate will possess deep technical knowledge of mainframe systems programming, SMP/E software management, IBM utilities, and ISV product lifecycle management , along with experience performing product migrations and conversions between competing vendor tools.
Key Responsibilities

• Install, configure, maintain, and upgrade third-party ISV software products in a z/OS environment.

• Lead initiatives to replace mainframe products with alternative vendor solutions.

• Perform product evaluations, proof-of-concepts, and technical comparisons of replacement tools.

• Plan and execute product migration and conversion activities , including configuration changes, data conversions, and operational cutovers.

• Maintain and manage software using SMP/E , including RECEIVE, APPLY, ACCEPT, USERMODs, and maintenance management.

• Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to ISV software installations, integrations, and runtime problems .

• Work with application teams, operations, and vendors to diagnose system or product issues.

• Develop and maintain installation documentation, procedures, and migration runbooks .

• Assist in capacity planning, performance tuning, and operational support for ISV tools.

• Support incident resolution and participate in root cause analysis for production issues involving ISV software.

• Evaluate compatibility and impact of new z/OS releases on installed ISV products.

Required Skills and Experience

• Extensive experience as a z/OS Systems Programmer supporting enterprise mainframe environments.

• Strong background in installation and maintenance of ISV mainframe software products .

• Hands-on experience with SMP/E software installation and maintenance processes .

• Experience performing product migrations or conversions between competing vendor tools .

• Strong troubleshooting and diagnostic skills across the z/OS platform.

• Experience with IBM utilities and system tools commonly used in z/OS environments.

• High-level working knowledge of TSO/ISPF environments and utilities.

• Experience supporting multi-vendor ISV ecosystems in production mainframe environments.

• Ability to analyze system documentation, vendor materials, and product architectures.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience specifically replacing ISV mainframe products with alternative vendor solutions.

• Familiarity with common ISV categories such as:

• Output management

• Security

• Scheduling

• Storage management

• Performance monitoring

• Database tools

• Automation operations

• Experience working with vendor support organizations to resolve complex technical issues.

• Knowledge of z/OS system internals, JES, RACF, and subsystem integration .

• Experience with automation, scripting, or operational tooling in the z/OS environment.

Personal Attributes

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to manage complex migrations and product transitions in production environments.

• Excellent documentation and communication skills.

• Self-motivated with the ability to work independently or as part of a systems engineering team.

• Ability to work on multiple client projects at the same time

Typical Deliverables

• ISV product installation documentation

• Migration and replacement project plans

• Troubleshooting guides and operational procedures

• Product comparison and evaluation reports

• Maintenance and upgrade schedules

title: DoW Sr. Information Systems Security Officer - Cloud
description:
Tetrad Digital Integrity (TDI) is a leading-edge cybersecurity firm with a mission to safeguard and protect our customers from increasing threats and vulnerabilities in this digital age. TDI is seeking a hands-on Senior Information Systems Security Officer (ISSO) to support U.S. Marine Corps cloud modernization in a fully remote role. You’ll help application teams securely onboard mission-critical workloads to modern cloud environments while supporting ATO efforts and translating RMF, NIST SP 800-53, and Cloud SRG requirements into actionable security deliverables.
This is a fully remote position supporting mission-critical U.S. Marine Corps programs. An active Secret clearance is required.
RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Lead and support RMF activities throughout all phases (categorization, control selection, implementation, assessment, authorization, and continuous monitoring).

• Provide expert guidance on DoW cloud security policies, NIST SP 800-53 controls, CNSS policies, and DoD-specific frameworks such as Cloud Computing SRG and AI-specific guidance.

• Conduct security architecture reviews and security engineering analysis for cloud-native and containerized workloads hosted in Azure.

• Evaluate security controls associated with Kubernetes, Docker, and container orchestration platforms within Azure.

• Assess security risks related to generative AI components, including large language models (LLMs) and AI/ML workloads, ensuring responsible and compliant use.

• Develop and maintain System Security Plans (SSPs), Security Assessment Reports (SARs), Plan of Action and Milestones (POA&Ms), and related RMF documentation.

• Perform threat modeling, vulnerability assessments, and risk analysis tailored to cloud environments and AI technologies.

• Interface with system architects, developers, and DevSecOps teams to integrate security throughout the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC).

• Support security control assessments (SCAs) and coordinate with third-party assessors.

• Monitor, track, and report on security compliance posture through Continuous Monitoring (ConMon) processes.

• Minimal travel will be required.

QUALIFICATIONS:

• Active Secret security clearance.

• A current Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) or Certified Information Security Manager (CISM) certification is required.

• Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, or Information Technology, and 8+ years of cybersecurity experience, including demonstrated experience supporting Risk Management Framework (RMF) activities for Department of War (DoW) systems.

• Candidates must have practical, hands-on experience with at least one cloud platform, including AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP), with demonstrated experience in IAM, VPC/networking, Kubernetes, and cloud security services.

• Strong knowledge of containerized environments (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes) and container security best practices.

• Familiarity with Generative AI technologies, including LLMs and AI/ML security considerations.

• Deep understanding of NIST SP 800-53, DoD RMF, FedRAMP, and other relevant cybersecurity frameworks.

• Experience writing and maintaining RMF artifacts such as SSPs, POA&Ms, and SARs.

• Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Experience with security risk assessments in DoW environments

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

• Advanced cloud security certifications, such as Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer, Cloud Certified Security Professional or Azure equivalent.

• Experience integrating DevSecOps pipelines with RMF compliance processes.

• Familiarity with automation tools for RMF documentation and control testing (e.g., Xacta, eMASS, OpenRMF).

PAY RANGE:
The anticipated salary range for this position is $130,000 - $160,000. This range is a good-faith estimate and not a guarantee of compensation. Final compensation will be based on factor

This leader must bring a strong market vision for the future of wholesale optical and fiber infrastructure, serve as a trusted advisor to strategic customers, and translate customer demand, market signals, and competitive insights into differentiated product strategy, roadmap direction, and commercial outcomes.

• Consult with customers and sales teams to develop solution constructs using existing product lines, including hybrid and lifecycle-based solutions that combine lit, dim, dark, and managed infrastructure options.

• Support GTM and product marketing efforts by helping define positioning, value propositions, use cases, sales enablement narratives, and customer-facing messaging for infrastructure solutions.

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent education and relevant experience; advanced business or technical education preferred.

• Deep expertise in optical and fiber

title: Senior AI Product Manager
description:
About 9fin

9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets - the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.

Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.

Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.

We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.

THE OPPORTUNITY

Our AI product area is growing. We already have two Product Managers working across conversational AI, agentic workflows, and domain-specific automation, and we need a third to expand our capacity as the scope of AI at 9fin accelerates.

Backed by over $170M in funding (Series C), we are scaling rapidly across product, engineering, and go-to-market. AI is not a bolt-on feature at 9fin; it is the core differentiator for the next phase of the company.

You will join an established AI PM team and take ownership of a product area within our AI surface. This could span new AI-powered features for credit analysts, workflow automation for legal and financial analysis, or expanding our conversational AI into new domains. The team has already built evaluation infrastructure and quality frameworks; you will use and contribute to these rather than build them from scratch.

You will work within our product organization (eight squads across AI, data, and domain verticals) and partner closely with ML engineers, data scientists, domain experts, and designers. This is a high-autonomy role with real scope to shape what 9fin's AI products can do for our clients.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

 

PRODUCT STRATEGY & EXECUTION

- Collaboratively create and champion a clear product vision and strategy for your area, with a focus on building and evolving our AI products

- Synthesize qualitative and quantitative insights into problem statements that identify root causes, not just symptoms

- Shape the next generation of agentic AI products: multi-step reasoning workflows, tool orchestration, and autonomous task completion for financial professionals

- Demonstrate a working understanding of the challenges specific to building with LLMs, including managing hallucinations, evaluating output quality, and designing for non-deterministic systems

- Use confidence-building methods (prototypes, user research, data analysis) to understand how users will interact with AI-powered products before committing to full builds

AI QUALITY & DATA

- Use the team's AI evaluation framework (LLM-as-judge protocols, quality thresholds, SME eval cycles) to validate and improve the products you ship

- Contribute to the data strategy for your product area: annotation quality, ground truth curation, and feedback loops that improve model performance over time

- Proactively identify and track metrics that measure client and business benefit, working with the team on continuous model evaluation and improvement

TEAM LEADERSHIP & COMMUNICATION

- Create a collaborative environment for your squad, providing wider context and clear goals so everyone can do their best work

- Work with data scientists and ML engineers to bridge the gap between business needs and the technical capabilities of AI models

- Communicate strategy, initiatives, and progress transparently across the organisation

- Translate complex AI concepts, capabilities, and limitations into language that non-technical stakeholders can act on

- Champion responsible AI practices: transparency in model outputs, bias monitoring

title: Tech Procurement Specialist
description:
TL;DR:

You'll own how Lovable sources and negotiates the vendor relationships that power the product: deals taken end-to-end from "an engineer needs this" to a signed contract, the economics modelled properly, and the process and data left better each time. Procurement judgement first, tooling second - we'll help you with the second part.

Why Lovable?

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.

We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.

The portfolio you'd own

This is a big book from day one. Lovable runs on a fast-growing stack of software, infrastructure and services, and the pace of that hasn't slowed since launch.

- 10-25 live processes at any given time, and a multi-million dollar value portfolio. Real money, genuinely custom commercial and legal terms, and no dedicated owner today. You’ll get to set the playbook, not inherit someone else's.

- Decisions that land in the P&L. These are numbers big enough to matter at company level, which means the gap between an average outcome and a sharp one is visible from the top. Few procurement roles offer this much line of sight from a single negotiation to the financials.

- A seat at the biggest tables. You'll work alongside Finance, Legal, EPD and Partnerships on the relationships that matter most to how the company operates, and the mandate grows as the company does - we're scaling fast, and so is what this role owns.

What we’re looking for

- You've done this before: tech procurement, strategic sourcing or vendor management, and you know the platforms and benchmarking sources that tell you what "good" looks like for a company our size.

- Commercially sharp negotiator: you compare offers, find leverage, and know when to push, when to walk away and when to escalate. You don't only chase a lower number: you reframe the shape of a contract so it works better for both sides. Precise, prepared, calm under pressure.

- Technically fluent and financially rigorous: you grasp technical concepts well enough to partner with Product and Engineering, translate requirements into commercial implications, and pressure-test vendor claims. You can also model pricing structures, commitments, credits, discounts, ramps, usage scenarios, renewal options, minimums and overages, and land on a clear recommendation.

- Process-minded: you ask where the data should live, what should be standard next time, and what should never again depend on someone remembering. One-off heroics become playbooks.

- Fluent enough in product and engineering context: you can sit with a PM or an engineer, understand what a vendor actually powers, and carry that into the commercial conversation.

- Data-comfortable and AI-native: messy data from contracts, invoices, billing exports, usage and vendor portals doesn't faze you, and you use AI as leverage by default. Some SQL, scripting or no-code helps. We'll support you here - curiosity matte

title: Director - End Market Development
description:
Role Overview

This position is a senior leadership role responsible for the strategic assessment and performance management of end market recycling facilities with a primary focus on plastics and fiber. Working at the intersection of policy and operations, the Director will evaluate opportunities to develop and expand end markets and ensure viability of funded facilities. This role is critical to achieving our diversion targets and fulfilling our obligations under EPR regulations.

The Director of End Market Development is a position on the End Markets team within the Material Services department of Program Planning and Operations (PPO), which also includes Compliance & Regulatory Affairs (CRA), Data & Analytics (D&A) and Emerging States. This position will need to actively collaborate with other departments both functionally within PPO (especially with the Collection & Processing team also within Material Services) and cross-functionally with Finance to ensure the end market development strategies align with CAA overall strategies.

The ideal candidate must combine strong operational background within the recycling industry, as well as strategic thinking and results-oriented skills to develop and maintain a successful relationship with end market entities.

This role will report to the VP of End Markets at CAA.

KPIs

• Recycling capacity growth: year over years added recycling capacities for targeted materials

• Development pipeline execution: number and value of projects advanced through diligence to approval, and percent of multi-year investment/intervention plan delivered on schedule.

• Partner/investor engagement: number of strategic partnerships (MOUs/SOWs/offtake-related agreements) executed and maintained in good standing.

• Cross-functional delivery: interest holder satisfaction and on-time delivery of agreed end-market work products to state/national teams (e.g., strategy, investment plan, reporting mechanisms).

• Team performance: annual goals achieved, SOW coverage for planned work, and retention/development of direct reports.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Planning for End Markets Support

• Develop and implement a multi-year recycling infrastructure development and support strategy, clearly defining CAA spend vs. outside third party spend, aligned with organizational EPR targets and material-specific goals.

• Identify companies that are ideal partners and lead engagement activities to drive expansion and development activity.

• Analyze business cases, feasibility studies, and capital plans submitted by facility operators and service providers.

• Support the VP End Markets in establishing and maintaining relationships with recycling facilities’ executive teams

• Collaborate with other teams to ensure collection and analysis of existing end market capacities data

• Oversee third-party technical audits and environmental assessments as required.

Portfolio Management & Opportunity Tracking

• Structure and negotiate funding agreements, grants, and performance-based contracts with recycling facility operators (in collaboration with the National Reimbursement Office and the Finance department).

• Review and assess facility performance against key performance indicators (KPIs) as established in agreement

• Identify underperforming investments and develop remediation plans or exit strategies in collaboration with program plan operation and legal teams.

• Continuously assess the recycling infrastructure landscape for gaps and opportunities.

Interest Holder Engagement & Partnerships

• Map and identify key partners as well as potential investors for new applications, new plants to take recycled materials, and new expansion opportunities of existing facilities.

• Build and maintain strong relationships with organizations providing funding, partnership opportunities, and with industry trade associations

About the Role
As part of the development team, the Front End Developer shall focus on developing user interface components for our web application and ensuring that these components are robust and easy to maintain. The current tech stack for this position requires proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript, CSS, and React, with the potential to expand as new technologies become available to the industry. In addition to core frontend skills, expertise in Cypress, Playwright, Storybook, Chromatic, or similar visual regression tools is essential, with a strong focus on testing and quality assurance. This position is designed for someone with substantial experience in both frontend development and testing.

• UI/UX Development: Develop new user-facing features, build reusable components and libraries for future use.

• Code Quality: Will ensure UI/UX designs' technical feasibility, optimize applications for speed and scalability, and maintain coding standards.

• Collaboration: Will collaborate closely with design and backend teams for web application enhancement, participating in code reviews to uphold code quality.

• Tech Stack: Will address performance and scalability issues and convert complex Figma designs into CSS/JS code, primarily using JavaScript libraries like React, ensuring seamless backend integration.

• Maintenance & Optimization: Will maintain and improve existing codebases, ensuring standard adherence through peer code reviews.

• Automated Testing: Take charge of automated testing processes, including writing and maintaining test scripts using tools like Cypress, Playwright, and Storybook, ensuring consistent quality and reliability.

Why Codekeeper ?
Codekeeper was founded by tech industry professionals to revolutionize software escrow for the cloud era. We offer state-of-the-art disaster recovery solutions that mitigate third-party risks in business operations. As a remote-first company with a central office in The Hague, we prioritize a healthy, resilient organization to support the development of our robust app.
🌐

• Passionate and fun-loving colleagues

• Startup mindset with ample opportunities for growth

• Regular team activities and gatherings

• Comprehensive onboarding process with a dedicated ramp-up period

• A supportive team that values open communication and direct feedback

• A chance to excel in your career and make a difference

About You

title: Software Engineer

To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. The Customer Experience Engineering Team builds the internal and external technologies that scale Snowflake’s global support and sales organizations. We empower our technical experts by providing the advanced tools they need to resolve complex issues and drive customer success.

Our team specializes in software engineering, data-driven decisions, ML, and LLM-based solutions. We build production-grade systems to automate manual processes and augment the capabilities of our technical staff. Our current focus includes:

- LLMs: Developing and deploying LLM and agent-based architectures for streamlining troubleshooting

- Scalable Evaluations: Implementing large-scale evaluations to ensure the quality and reliability of our internal and external tools

- Process Automation: Designing intelligent workflows that eliminate bottlenecks and allow our experts to focus on the most technical aspects of the Snowflake platform

- Incident discovery: using embeddings, LLMs, clustering, and agents to detect potential widespread issues more quickly

Now, the team is growing, and we are looking for a Software Engineer to join us. In this role, you will work closely with the state of the art LLM models, fine-tune them, develop agents, apply various clusterings, summarizations, embeddings, and so on. Even though we usually use high-level libraries (e.g., scikit or Snowflake’s Cortex) rather than perform matrix multiplications ourselves, some prior ML experience is definitely useful.

As a Software Engineer, you will contribute to the development of ML and LLM-based solutions, propose new ideas, and keep improving the existing models.

You will:

- Develop and refine ML models that are critical to Snowflake’s business

- Design metrics and experiments to validate your insights

- Help to implement projects that span our stack, including Java and Python services hosted in Snowflake and Kubernetes

- Collaborate with a cross-functional team, including product management and design

- Deliver features requiring close coordination with several partner teams

- Be a participant in defining the product vision and team planning

- Pinpoint problems, instrument relevant components as needed, and ultimately implement solutions

Our ideal Software Engineer will have:

- B.S. or M.S. degree in CS, or equivalent discipline

- 3+ years of hands-on software engineering experience

- 1+ years of working ML experience

- Interest in the State of the Art LLM-based solutions

- Great communication skills, both verbal and written and an interest in working with a diverse set of peers and external developers

- Genuine enjoyment of the art of building great software, and a love of learning new things

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

title: AI Service Analyst
description:
AI Service Analyst
ICS.AI · Remote (UK), occasional travel to Basingstoke and client sites
· Full-time, permanent · £26,500 - £30,000 · Entry level / graduate
Build the AI agents that run our service desk - not reset passwords.
ICS.AI is a UK AI consultancy delivering AI transformation to the public sector - local government, higher education and the wider public estate. Our clients commit to transformation on the strength of savings guarantees, and we are held to contractual service levels once our solutions are live. That makes our service data a commercial asset, not admin overhead.
We are hiring an AI Service Analyst to own the day-to-day operation of our service management function, and to build it properly from the ground up. You will be the single point of coordination between clients raising issues, the delivery and engineering teams who resolve them, and the Customer Success team who own the relationship.
This is a first or second role. You do not need to be able to fix the technology. You need to be able to work out what is actually happening, get it to the right person, and tell the client the truth about it clearly and on time.
What you’ll be doing

• Running our Zendesk platform end to end - reviewing every incoming ticket, categorising and prioritising it against a consistent ITIL-aligned model, assigning it to the right resolver and chasing it to closure.

• Early triage on live AI solutions: checking Azure service health, interrogating voice and language platforms, and reproducing what a client is reporting before it consumes a specialist’s time.

• Problem management and root cause analysis - spotting patterns across incidents, assigning causes, and authoring RCA documents that go to clients.

• Client communication and service reporting: proactive updates, SLA tracking, the weekly report pack, and service content for monthly and quarterly reviews.

• Monthly trend analysis across the client portfolio, and the structured feedback loop from live service into our product roadmap.

• Designing, building, shadow-running and tuning AI agents inside Zendesk for triage, classification and first response - including the guardrails that decide what an agent is never allowed to handle alone.

What makes this different from a service desk role
You will not be resetting passwords. Our tickets concern live AI solutions serving citizens and council staff - conversational assistants, voice services, agents and data platforms. And a genuine part of the job is building AI agents to handle the queue: that is what lets the function absorb a growing client base without growing headcount, and it is the difference between this post and a conventional service desk appointment. It is no-code work, but it needs someone who will iterate patiently rather than accept the first output.
What we’re looking for
We are not screening on a degree classification or a specific subject. What we care about is evidence of the following:

• Excellent written English - clear, accurate and appropriate for a professional client audience.

• Strong organisational discipline, and the ability to hold many open items without losing any of them.

• An analytical mindset; comfortable with numbers and spotting patterns.

• Confidence and composure in direct contact with clients by email, phone and video, including when they are unhappy.

• Competence with Microsoft 365, particularly Excel.

• A genuine interest in AI and in how technology is used in public services.

• Eligibility to work in the UK. We are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Nice to have

• ITIL 4 Foundation - not required at appointment; we will fund it within your first three months.

• Any exposure to a ticketing platform (Zendesk, ServiceNow, Freshdesk, Jira Service Management), including a placement year.

• Experience of local government, higher education or the wider public sector.

• Familiarity with generative AI tools, or any experience of configuring or prompting them

title: Security Engineer - Platform Security
description:
We believe that the way people interact with their finances will drastically improve in the next few years. We’re dedicated to empowering this transformation by building the tools and experiences that thousands of developers use to create their own products. Plaid powers the tools millions of people rely on to live a healthier financial life. We work with thousands of companies like Venmo, SoFi, several of the Fortune 500, and many of the largest banks to make it easy for people to connect their financial accounts to the apps and services they want to use. Plaid’s network covers 12,000 financial institutions across the US, Canada, UK and Europe. Founded in 2013, the company is headquartered in San Francisco with offices in New York, Seattle, Washington D.C., Raleigh, London, and Amsterdam.

The Platform Security team (PlatSec) defends Plaid against attackers. We own laptop security, cloud security, AI security, detection and response, and red teaming. Right now we're in growth mode. AI has expanded Plaid's attack surface faster than most security teams can adapt, and we're building the guardrails, identity controls, and detection systems to keep pace without slowing the business down. If you like solving problems nobody's solved yet, this is that team.

About the role
You'll be Plaid's first line of defense on AI security. You'll review new AI technologies to find security risks before they ship, then design and implement the controls that close them. You'll build the guardrails, identity management, and detection systems that let Plaid use AI aggressively without getting burned.

Responsibilities

- Review AI systems and integrations for security risk before and after deployment.

- Design and deploy guardrails, sandboxes, and other controls that contain what AI agents can do.

- Build or implement systems to track and manage AI identities, so we know what access every AI has been granted and can balance risk with agility.

- Detect and mitigate prompt injection across Plaid's AI surface area.

- Run AI-focused security reviews and set the bar other teams build to.

- Your impact: fewer AI-related incidents, faster AI shipping, and controls that scale. Plaid wants to be a leader in AI, internally and externally, and we can’t do that safely without you.

Qualifications
Must-have: hands-on experience securing AI technologies, including at least one of:

- deploying guardrails or sandboxes,

- managing AI identities,

- detecting or mitigating prompt injection,

- running AI security reviews, or

- implementing AI security tooling (built or bought).

- Nice-to-haves:

- Experience at a frontier AI lab or on a security team defending production AI systems at scale.

- Experience on a Infrastructure Security, Cloud Security, Platform Security, Corporate Security, Security Operations (SecOps), and/or Detection & Response team

- Software security review, SDLC, vulnerability discovery, and/or offensive security experience

Our mission at Plaid is to unlock financial freedom for everyone. To support that mission, we seek to build a diverse team of driven individuals who care deeply about making the financial ecosystem more equitable. We recognize that strong qualifications can come from both prior work experiences and lived experiences. We encourage you to apply to a role even if your experience doesn't fully match the job description. We are always looking for team members that will bring something unique to Plaid!

Plaid is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and values diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, color, national origin, ethnicity, religion or religious belief, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, military or veteran status, disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. title: Chief Regulatory Affairs Officer (CRAO)
description:
Role Summary
The Chief Regulatory Affairs Officer (CRAO) is responsible for leading the organization's regulatory strategy, ensuring compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and industry requirements while supporting business growth and market expansion. The CRAO serves as the primary liaison with regulators, government agencies, and industry bodies, proactively managing regulatory risks and influencing policy developments that impact the organization.
Key Responsibilities
1. Regulatory Strategy & Leadership

• Develop and execute the organization's regulatory affairs strategy aligned with business objectives.

• Advise the CEO, Board, and executive leadership on regulatory developments and emerging risks.

• Anticipate regulatory changes and assess their impact on business operations and strategy.

• Lead regulatory engagement initiatives to support corporate growth and innovation.

2. Regulatory Compliance Oversight

• Ensure enterprise-wide compliance with applicable regulations, laws, and industry standards.

• Establish regulatory compliance frameworks, policies, and controls.

• Monitor compliance performance and implement corrective actions where necessary.

• Oversee regulatory reporting and disclosure requirements.

3. Government & Regulatory Relations

• Serve as the primary point of contact with regulatory authorities and government agencies.

• Manage regulatory examinations, inspections, and audits.

• Build and maintain strong relationships with regulators, policymakers, and industry associations.

• Represent the organization in regulatory consultations and industry forums.

4. Policy Development & Regulatory Advocacy

• Monitor legislative and regulatory developments.

• Analyze proposed regulations and provide strategic recommendations.

• Influence policy discussions through engagement with industry stakeholders.

• Coordinate responses to consultations, policy papers, and regulatory inquiries.

5. Risk Management & Governance

• Identify, assess, and mitigate regulatory risks.

• Collaborate with Legal, Compliance, Risk, and Internal Audit functions.

• Ensure alignment between regulatory requirements and enterprise governance frameworks.

• Provide regular regulatory risk reporting to executive leadership and the Board.

6. Licensing & Regulatory Approvals

• Oversee licensing, registrations, certifications, and regulatory approvals.

• Support market entry initiatives and expansion into new jurisdictions.

• Ensure timely submission of regulatory applications and filings.

• Manage regulatory approval processes for new products and services.

7. Regulatory Change Management

• Lead implementation of new regulatory requirements across the organization.

• Coordinate cross-functional regulatory projects and remediation programs.

• Ensure business units understand and comply with regulatory obligations.

• Develop regulatory training and awareness programs.

8. Team Leadership & Capability Building

• Build and lead a high-performing regulatory affairs team.

• Develop regulatory expertise across the organization.

• Manage regulatory affairs budgets and external advisory relationships.

• Promote a culture of compliance and proactive regulatory engagement.

Qualifications & Experience

• Bachelor's degree in Law, Business, Finance, Public Policy, Economics, Healthcare, Science, or related field.

• Master's degree, MBA, JD, LLB, or relevant professional qualification preferred.

• 15+ years of experience in regulatory affairs, compliance, legal, risk, or government relations.

• Minimum 5+ years in a senior leadership role overseeing regulatory functions.

• Strong experience engaging with regulators and government authorities.

• Deep understanding of industry-specific regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements.

Key Competencies

• Regulatory Strategy & Governance

Télécom SudParis est co- fondatrice de l'Institut Polytechnique de Paris (IP Paris), Institut de Sciences et Technologies à vocation mondiale avec l’École polytechnique, l’ENSTA Paris, l’ENSAE Paris, l'ENPC et Télécom Paris. Vidéo présentation de Télécom SudParis
À propos de l'Institut Mines-Télécom :
L'Institut Mines-Télécom (IMT) est un établissement public dédié à l'enseignement supérieur et la recherche pour l'innovation dans les domaines de l'ingénierie et du numérique. À l’écoute permanente du monde économique, l'IMT conjugue une forte légitimité académique et scientifique, une proximité avec les entreprises et un positionnement unique sur les transformations majeures au XXIe siècle : numériques, énergétiques, industrielles et éducatives siècle. Ses activités se déploient au sein des grandes écoles Mines et Télécom sous tutelle du ministre en charge de l’Industrie et des communications électroniques, de deux filiales et de partenaires associés ou sous convention. L'IMT est membre fondateur de l’Alliance Industrie du Futur. Il est doublement labellisé Carnot pour la qualité de sa recherche partenariale. Vidéo de présentation de l'Institut Mines-Télécom

Missions

• Assurer des missions de recherche en théorie de l’information quantique, avec un accent particulier sur les systèmes quantiques bosoniques

• Assurer des missions d’encadrement et de tutorat des étudiants

• Contribuer à la notoriété de Télécom SudParis, de l’Institut Mines-Télécom et de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris

Activités

• Assurer des activités de recherche en théorie de l’information quantique

• Étudier les propriétés mathématiques et informationnelles des états et canaux quantiques bosoniques, en mettant particulièrement l’accent sur les systèmes non gaussiens.

• Étudier et chercher à démontrer des inégalités entropiques quantiques intervenant en théorie de l’information quantique bosonique, notamment des inégalités liées à l’action des diviseurs de faisceau et d’autres transformations bosoniques physiquement pertinentes.

• Développer de nouveaux outils mathématiques pour l’analyse des états et canaux bosoniques non gaussiens, en s’appuyant notamment sur des méthodes issues de la théorie de l’information quantique, de l’analyse matricielle et des opérateurs, de la théorie de la majorisation et de domaines connexes.

• Appliquer ces résultats à la caractérisation de la transmission de l’information à travers les canaux quantiques bosoniques, en particulier à l’établissement de formules de capacité ainsi que de bornes supérieures ou inférieures sur les capacités de communication.

• Explorer les liens entre les méthodes développées et d’autres problématiques de la théorie de l’information quantique et de la physique mathématique.

• Contribuer à la réalisation des objectifs scientifiques et des livrables du projet de recherche.

• Présenter et discuter les résultats de recherche au sein de l’équipe ainsi qu’avec des collaborateurs extérieurs.

• Préparer des publications scientifiques présentant les résultats des travaux de recherche.

2. Assurer des activités d’enseignement, d’encadrement et de tutorat

Hello. We’re Teya.

Teya was founded on a simple belief: local businesses deserve better.

They are the cafés, restaurants, salons, shops and entrepreneurs that bring character to our high streets, create jobs and keep communities moving. Yet for too long, financial services has made life harder for them - with clunky tools, poor support and complexity that gets in the way of running a business.

Teya exists to change that.

We’re building a financial platform for local businesses across Europe - one built around simple tools, thoughtful design and real human support. Our Members rely on us to help them run their business with confidence, and that responsibility shapes the way we work.

We move fast. We care about quality. We stay close to the detail. And we believe great performance and genuine hospitality should go hand in hand.

If you want to build meaningful products, solve real problems and make a genuine difference for local businesses, we’d love to hear from you

TO BE A TEYAN

We are not just a fintech company. We develop people by giving them the autonomy and the responsibility to challenge the status quo, so they can be the main actors of the change we want to bring to the market.

We are always looking for people better than us to join the team, disrupt payments, and revolutionise commerce in Europe. The goal we share, the mission is one, and at the end of the day we are just people trying to help other people.

WHAT IS YOUR MISSION?

Our sales agents are on the front lines, talking to merchants every day. Across the go to market systems they use to manage their sales, HubSpot CRM is where their deals, activities, conversations, reporting, automations and portfolio lives. When HubSpot works, our salespeople sell. When it breaks quietly in the background, deals stall, data drifts, and the people who trust the numbers stop trusting the tool.

Your mission is to be the guardian of that system. You are the person who keeps HubSpot healthy, honest, and trustworthy, so that every seller and every leader can rely on it without ever thinking about it.

This is not a caretaking job where you wait for tickets and tick them off. You are a detective and a builder. You go looking for what is wrong before anyone reports it, you find the real reason something failed instead of patching the symptom, and you make sure the same failure never happens twice. You turn a messy, growing CRM into a system people can trust, and you can prove it with data.

AS THE GUARDIAN OF OUR CRM YOU WILL

Investigate root causes, not symptoms. When something in HubSpot fails, you own it. You dig into what actually went wrong, validate the real root cause, and drive it to a fix. You are the single point of contact when the CRM misbehaves, and nothing gets dropped on your watch.

Prevent the next bug before it happens. You do not just close errors, you learn from them. You spot the patterns, harden the implementations that keep breaking, and put guardrails in place so a whole class of problems disappears. Every automation and implementation, local or global, follows our guidelines because you make sure it does, before and after it goes live.

Measure the health of the CRM. You build the dashboards that show, at a glance, whether what we ship actually works and keeps working. You track error rates, adoption, and data quality over time, so CRM health stops being a feeling and becomes a number we can watch and improve.

Turn data into action. You are as comfortable reading the numbers as fixing the system. You globalise and clean up our reporting once the requirements from Commercial Excellence are aligned, retire the dashboards no one needs, and use data to find the problems no one has noticed yet.

Build and improve, hands on. You create new automations and refine the ones we have, you read the logic of a workflow well enough to debug it, and you keep the instance clean, governed, and scalable across every market in Europe.

About Paralucent
Paralucent brings clarity to complex work, helping organisations move beyond complexity towards clarity through practical, thoughtful technology solutions.

Paralucent Core Values
We’re Driven to deliver real outcomes, and we Take Ownership from first question to final result. Why This Role Matters
You will enable Agile delivery teams to work predictably, collaboratively and with a clear focus on value. As an experienced Scrum Master, you will facilitate Scrum ceremonies, remove delivery impediments and support continuous improvement in a SAFe environment. You will partner closely with Product Owners, Release Train Engineers and cross-functional stakeholders to strengthen team maturity, align delivery to programme objectives and help teams deliver meaningful outcomes.
Requirements
Key Responsibilities:

• Facilitate Agile ceremonies, including daily stand-ups, sprint planning, backlog refinement, sprint reviews and retrospectives.

• Coach delivery teams on Scrum, Agile principles and SAFe practices to improve delivery predictability and team maturity.

• Support Programme Increment planning, including dependency management, risk identification and alignment to programme objectives.

• Partner with Product Owners to maintain healthy, prioritised product backlogs and clearly defined user stories.

• Identify, track and remove impediments affecting team performance or delivery timelines.

• Monitor and communicate delivery health, including sprint progress, velocity, capacity, risks, dependencies and delivery metrics.

• Drive continuous improvement through actionable retrospectives and measurable process enhancements.

• Strengthen collaboration across development, QA, product, architecture and business teams.

• Maintain Agile delivery artefacts in Azure DevOps, including boards, dashboards, reports and work item tracking.

Qualifications:

• 5+ years of experience as a Scrum Master, Agile Coach or in a related Agile delivery role.

• Strong experience applying Scrum and Agile delivery practices within software or technology teams.

• Experience working in a SAFe environment, including Programme Increment planning and cross-team dependency management.

• Hands-on Azure DevOps experience, including backlog management, sprint boards, dashboards, queries, reporting and work item tracking.

• Demonstrated ability to facilitate meetings, resolve impediments and guide teams through change.

• Strong communication, stakeholder management and conflict resolution skills.

• Experience partnering with Product Owners and technical teams to improve backlog readiness and sprint execution.

Nice to Have

• Scrum Master certification, such as PSM, CSM or SAFe Scrum Master.

• SAFe certification, such as SAFe Agilist or SAFe Scrum Master.

• Experience supporting multiple Agile teams or Agile Release Trains.

• Familiarity with Agile metrics, including velocity, burndown or burnup, cycle time, lead time and predictability.

• Experience supporting enterprise software delivery, DevOps, cloud or digital transformation programmes.

If you want to do work you’re proud of, with people who own the outcome, this is your place.

The Manager, Development leads the strategic direction and operational execution of multiple software development teams, typically managing a one-to-three-year roadmap horizon. In this role, you collaborate closely with cross-functional partners to deliver critical software initiatives, ensuring continuous alignment with organizational objectives. You actively foster team development, optimize productivity, and promote an agile, collaborative environment. Through strategic leadership and effective communication, you drive technical excellence, innovation, and a culture of continuous improvement. You lead AI-First teams, where AI agents are the default way work is planned, built, tested, and reviewed, and you are accountable for doing so with the verification, governance, and measurement discipline our regulated environment requires.
Job Responsibilities

•
Team Leadership & Management: Attracts, hires, coaches, and retains high-performing software development engineers, actively developing personalized career plans that include AI fluency progression, and promptly addressing performance issues.

•
Accountable Delivery: Effectively plans, manages, and leads the delivery of roadmap items, including product and modernization initiatives, leveraging AI-driven workflows to compress cycle time while holding quality and reliability constant.

•
Organizational Alignment: Maintains a 360-degree alignment between product roadmap, architectural strategy, and software development processes to ensure the delivery of value-generating software solutions.

•
Collaboration: Works proactively with cross-functional partners (product management, architecture, QA, operations) to clearly define strategic goals and maintain transparency in planning, execution, and delivery.

•
Architecture & Technology Strategy: Actively contributes to shaping and evolving the architectural and development strategies, aligning closely with product roadmaps, ensuring scalability, maintainability, and quality.

•
Quality and Continuous Improvement: Promotes a culture of quality and continuous improvement by implementing Agile and Lean Development methodologies in collaboration with cross-functional partners, fostering a shift-left mindset, holding AI-generated code to the same test coverage, review, and security standards as human-authored code, and ensuring consistent developer engagement and productivity improvements.

•
Customer Experience: Delivers excellent customer experiences by ensuring high-quality, reliable software products.

•
Scalability: Participates in defining architectural direction and development strategies to ensure scalable and maintainable software solutions.

•
Security: Provides leadership in application security remediation activities and mentors on implementing security remediation and secure programming practices; ensures secure use of AI tooling, including approved tools only, least-privilege agent permissions, no sensitive or customer data in unapproved systems, and a full audit trail for agent-made changes.

•
Technical Contribution: Contributes technically when needed, including directing and reviewing agentic work, and maintains strong hands-on engagement with the team’s AI toolchain to support the team and organizational outcomes.

Technology Innovation: Actively contributes to evolving the organization's core technology stack through innovative adoption and enhancement of cloud, web, mobile, microservices, big data, and API-enabled platforms.

title: Infrastructure Engineer (m/f/d) - IT Infrastructure Services
description:
At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable.  

We're looking for a motivated and driven IT Infrastructure Engineer (m/f/d) who will help us shape our team, drive the company to the next level, and have a direct influence on our success.

As an IT Infrastructure Engineer, you lead the efforts of maintaining and improving our global identity and access management platform as a coherent set of highly available services following our cloud-focused strategy. It is your responsibility to identify improvement opportunities, drive identity projects, and build a unified, scalable environment.

Based in Germany and the US, our IT Infrastructure Services team designs, implements, and manages global cloud and on-premises infrastructure solutions to provide Flix with internal business services such as identity and access management, security and compliance configuration, communication tools, file sharing, 3rd-level support, and infrastructure consulting.

About the Role

• Integrate new internal and external applications into our identity infrastructure (e.g., SSO ) following best practices

• Work on projects to improve internal role-based access control concepts

• Consult other teams and guide them to success, leveraging our services especially regarding identity and access management

• Drive innovation and improve our services together with the team

• Automate recurring tasks

• Design the future IT infrastructure of Flix

About You

• At least 3 years of experience with Microsoft Entra ID or similar identity and access management platforms

• Advanced knowledge of modern authentication protocols ( OIDC , OAuth 2.0, and SAML )

• At least 3 years of scripting experience (ideally with Python)

• At least 1 year of experience with IaC solutions (preferably Terraform)

• Hands-on experience leveraging AI tools to streamline infrastructure automation, troubleshooting, and daily operations

• Basic experience using APIs

• Experience with containerization and orchestration platforms (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes) is a plus

• Experience working with IaaS solutions is a plus

• Basic knowledge of modern frontend frameworks (e.g., React) or web technologies is a plus

• Experience with M365 products (such as Exchange Online, SharePoint/OneDrive, and Microsoft Teams) is a plus

We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!  

What We Offer

• Travel perks : 12 free Flix vouchers + 12 discount vouchers for friends & family. 

• Work from (M)Anywhere : Depending on your role, work from another location for up to 60 days per year. 

• Hybrid work model : We are an office-first company, but we offer flexibility to balance work and life. 

• Wellbeing support : Access confidential 1:1 counselling, courses, and stress management for yourself and up to four family members. 

• Learning & Development : Take advantage of language classes, training courses, and expert-led sessions to grow your skills. 

• Mentoring Program : Connect with experienced colleagues to gain insights and accelerate your career. 

To view more local benefits specific to each office location, please check out this link:   Locations - Flix Career

Why Join Flix?

At Flix, you’ll find teams that rally together to overcome challenges and spark creativity. We believe in ownership culture - giving you the freedom to take initiative, make an impact, and shape your own career path.
As we continue to expand across the globe, you can make a real difference in how we work.

If you’re ready to grow and lead your journey, Flix is the place for you!

title: QA Engineer
description:
Hi! I'm Shriya https://www.linkedin.com/in/shriya-baddula-4b0b41386, and I lead QA at Ashby.

We're hiring a QA Engineer to help us test and strengthen the quality of our product.

I think of QA as something you build into the system, not as something you layer on top for added confidence. I'm not interested in gatekeeping quality or creating a process for its own sake. I care about feedback that's fast and useful, the kind engineers trust, and catching the problems users would actually notice.

That's what brought me to Ashby. Engineers take on a lot of ownership, including the quality of their work, which often means they test it themselves. QA here isn't about convincing people to care or taking quality off their plate. It's about being another set of eyes on a fast-evolving product. Sometimes that means seeing the edge case. Sometimes that means spotting the product's blind spot before it hits production.

In this role, you'll decide what to test, when to test, and which product areas are worth automating. We're a small team, so the work is mixed. We all roll up our sleeves when needed.

Most of your time, roughly 70%, is hands-on manual testing. You'll work with engineers and other stakeholders on features as they ship, reproduce bugs reported by customers, and, for larger launches, coordinate testing across an entire feature area.

The other 30% is automation. You'll write Playwright end-to-end tests and help expand test coverage. You do not need to be an SDET, and you do not need to have built a framework from scratch. You do need to be comfortable writing code, reading someone else's code, and getting better at both. If you've written some E2E tests and want to write more, that's the right starting point. We have an existing Playwright suite and page object structure you'll build on, and SDETs who will pair with you and help you grow.

What Ashby gives you in return is the best of both early and growth-stage environments. The agency and no-nonsense of a seed startup: you decide what to test, work directly with the people building it, and operate in an almost-no-meeting culture. The product-market fit and scale of a growth-stage startup: 100,000+ weekly active users who depend on our software, which means the things you catch actually matter.

We have notable customers like Notion, Linear, Shopify, and Snowflake. Our growth and retention metrics are best-in-class among our peers: we have tens of millions in ARR, growing >100% year over year, very low churn, and many years of runway. We’ll share more details once we meet.

WHY YOU SHOULD OR SHOULDN’T APPLY

- You have strong product instincts. You test like a user and know the difference between "it works" and "it works the way someone would actually use it."

- You're good at reproducing bugs. When something is broken, you narrow it down. You don't file vague bugs and move on.

- You are self-sufficient and can scope your own work. Given a feature and a spec, you decide what's worth testing and what’s not, and you know when to ask for help when something is taking too long.

- You want to grow on the automation side. You don't need to be an expert to be interested. You want to write more tests, get faster at it, and learn from the engineers around you.

- You write clearly. Your writing should be concise, clear, and easy to follow.

PUT ANOTHER WAY, YOU SHOULDN'T APPLY IF

- You think of QA as gatekeeping. We don't have sign-off gates, and we're not adding them. Your influence comes from the quality of your judgment, not from a checkbox.

- You're happiest when someone hands you a test plan and a set of instructions. This role operates on ownership, with you often deciding what to test and why.

- You want to stay at the surface. Testing Ashby well means understanding it well. The interesting problems are several layers in.

- You’re used to working on large QA teams with lots of ceremony and fixed roles.

- You want a pure automation or SDET role. The majority of this

title: Software Engineer - Postgres
description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset - who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

The Snowflake Postgres team is building a managed Postgres experience inside Snowflake. This role is focused on the control plane, where you have the opportunity to work on both on distributed systems at scale and also to work on research grade optimizations at various layers of the software stack including but not limited to provisioning, managing, securing, and operating Postgres in Snowflake. You will work on core backend systems that sit at the intersection of distributed systems, database infrastructure, security, and operational excellence.

IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

- Design and build backend services that power provisioning, lifecycle management, and configuration of Snowflake Postgres instances.

- Develop features in the access and user model, including authorization, secure administration flows, and customer-facing management capabilities.

- Improve the reliability, observability, and operability of asynchronous workflows and background systems that keep the service healthy.

- Partner with product, security, and adjacent engineering teams to deliver simple customer experiences on top of complex infrastructure.

- Investigate production issues, participate in on-call, and drive fixes that improve resilience and reduce operational burden.

- Contribute to technical design, code review, and mentoring while helping raise the engineering bar across the team.

OUR IDEAL CANDIDATE WILL HAVE:

- 2+ years of experience building production software in backend, infrastructure, or distributed systems environments.

- Strong programming skills in one or more of Java, Go, C++, or Python.

- Strong computer science fundamentals, including concurrency, networking, APIs, and data structures.

- Experience designing and operating reliable services in production, including debugging, monitoring, and incident response.

- Experience working across technical boundaries with product, security, and other engineering teams.

- BS/MS in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

NICE TO HAVE:

- Experience with PostgreSQL, database internals, or managed database platforms.

- Experience with identity, authorization, RBAC, or other security-sensitive systems.

- Experience with cloud infrastructure on AWS, Azure, or GCP.

- Experience with workflow orchestration, control plane systems, or highly asynchronous service architectures.

WHY JOIN THIS TEAM?

- Work on a strategic product area that expands Snowflake into transactional and operational database workloads

- Build systems that directly shape how customers create, manage, and secure Postgres inside Snowflake

- Tackle a mix of product engineering, infrastructure, reliability, and security problems.

- Join a collaborative team with meaningful ownership, strong technical challenges, and room to grow

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.
